d:
Ranchi men patrakaron ke sath kathit anyay aur pulis ki karravaee ko lekar siyasi mahaul garma gaya hai. patrakaron ke samarthan men utre BJP neta ne pulis ke khilaph jamkar narajgi jataee aur adhikariyon ko khari-khoti sunaee. unhonne patrakaron ke sath nyay karne aur pure mamle men nishpaksh karravaee ki mang ki. aakhir kya hai pura mamla?
